rationale: Junior Civil / Structural Engineer at Silver Wolf Projects, North Lakes QLD: site inspections, engineering reports, scopes of works and design plans, AutoCAD and Revit drafting for builders, insurers and loss adjusters.

Qualification fits (B. Eng. Civil or Structural, Cert IV or building degree; Marc holds a BSCE and an Advanced Diploma), plus licence, White Card, AutoCAD and Revit (academic), report writing and site inspections from the Philippines.

The advert also lists understanding of the NCC including the BCA, and onsite design or commercial building construction experience; neither is clearly on record, and the work is forensic building diagnostics rather than civil infrastructure.
